```{r}
#Re-classify the one individual who was mislabelled nivo+ipi, when they were ipi+pembro:
```

#Step 1: Covariate Cleaning:
1. Stage at Dx: categorical
  a. Drop the stage variable created earlier.
  b. Reconstruct  two stage variables, one specific with AJCC as priority, the other using seer summary stage.
  b. Final variable names: STAGE_GROUP (SEER), STAGE_LABEL (AJCC)
  d. STAGE_GROUP will be used for table 1 and 2, STAGE_LABEL will be used for PSM

```{r}
#exploring the best stage variable to use
addmargins(table(data$STAGE_SOURCE, data$STAGE_GROUP, useNA ="ifany"))
table(data$COMBINED_SUMMARY_STAGE_2004)
table(data$DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP6THED20042, useNA ="ifany") #1624 missing
addmargins(table(data$COMBINED_SUMMARY_STAGE_2004, useNA ="ifany"))
#  1    2    7    9  Sum 
# 719  864  585    9 2177 
# localized (code 1), regional (codes 2-4) (2= regional by direct extension only, 3= regional lymph only, 4= regional lymo AND direct extension),  distant (code 7), benign (code 8), unknown (unstaged, unknown or unspecified) (code 9)
# guidelines fro summary stage here: https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/Summary-Stage_v3.3.pdf
# combined_summary_stage_2004 is the best code to use, It is: "Created from SEER Combined Summary Stage 2000 (2004-2017) & Derived  Summary Stage 2018 (2018+). #For more information including sites, years and registries for which it isn't calculated, see https://seer.cancer.gov/seerstat/variables/seer/lrd-stage/

#drop old stage labels
data <- data %>% select(-c(STAGE_SOURCE, STAGE_LABEL, STAGE_GROUP))
```

```{r}
#create a new, more specific stage variable, stage_label, that preserves specificity----------
library(dplyr)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    # ---------------------------------
    # Step 1: AJCC 7th (2013–2015)
    # ---------------------------------
    STAGE_LABEL = case_when(
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 %in% c("110","120") ~ "1A",
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 == "150" ~ "1B",
      
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 %in% c("310","320") ~ "2A",
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 == "330" ~ "2B",
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 == "340" ~ "2C",
      
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 %in% c("500","510") ~ "3",
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 == "520" ~ "3A",
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 == "530" ~ "3B",
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 == "540" ~ "3C",
      
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 == "700" ~ "4",
      
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2013 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2015 &
        DERIVEDAJCCSTAGEGROUP7THED20102 == "999" ~ "99",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # ---------------------------------
    # Step 2: SEER Combined (2016–2017)
    # already labeled → just pull it
    # ---------------------------------
    STAGE_LABEL = if_else(
      is.na(STAGE_LABEL) &
        YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2016 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2017 &
        DERIVEDSEERCMBSTG_GRP_2016_2017 != "",
      DERIVEDSEERCMBSTG_GRP_2016_2017,
      STAGE_LABEL
    ),
    
    # ---------------------------------
    # Step 3: EOD 2018 (2018–2019)
    # already labeled → just pull it
    # ---------------------------------
    STAGE_LABEL = if_else(
      is.na(STAGE_LABEL) &
        YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS >= 2018 & YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS <= 2019 &
        DERIVEDEOD2018_STAGE_GROUP_2018 != "",
      DERIVEDEOD2018_STAGE_GROUP_2018,
      STAGE_LABEL
    )
  )

addmargins(table(data$YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS, data$STAGE_LABEL, useNA = "ifany"))

#so, create a new variable where it combines stage_label and with SEER summary stage, adding NOS to seer.
    # so levels: stage I NOS, II-III NOS, IV
    addmargins(table(data$COMBINED_SUMMARY_STAGE_2004))
    
    data %>%
      filter(is.na(STAGE_LABEL) | STAGE_LABEL == "99") %>%
      count(COMBINED_SUMMARY_STAGE_2004, sort = TRUE)
#when combined == 7, stage_label is.na = 4:
    
    data <- data %>%
      mutate(
        STAGE_LABEL = if_else(
          (is.na(STAGE_LABEL) | STAGE_LABEL == "99") &
            COMBINED_SUMMARY_STAGE_2004 == 7,
          "4",
          STAGE_LABEL
        )
      )
    addmargins(table(data$STAGE_LABEL, useNA = "ifany"))

#now label stage_label as "1 NOS" when empty, but summary ==1
    data <- data %>%
      mutate(
        STAGE_LABEL = if_else(
          (is.na(STAGE_LABEL) | STAGE_LABEL == "99") &
            COMBINED_SUMMARY_STAGE_2004 == 1,
          "1 NOS",
          STAGE_LABEL
        )
      )
#now label stage_label as II-III NOS when stage_label empty, but summary = 2
    
    data <- data %>%
      mutate(
        STAGE_LABEL = if_else(
          (is.na(STAGE_LABEL) | STAGE_LABEL == "99") &
            COMBINED_SUMMARY_STAGE_2004 == 2,
          "II–III NOS",
          STAGE_LABEL
        )
      )
    
#finally, collapse stage_lablel 2 and 3 with stage_label II-III NOS:
    data <- data %>%
      mutate(
        STAGE_LABEL = as.character(STAGE_LABEL),
        STAGE_LABEL = if_else(
          STAGE_LABEL %in% c("2", "3"),
          "II–III NOS",
          STAGE_LABEL
        )
      )
    
   
addmargins(table(data$STAGE_LABEL, useNA = "ifany"))  
#merging new stage label back into data

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    stage_recode = factor(
      STAGE_LABEL,
      levels = c(
        "1 NOS",
        "1A",
        "1B",
        "2A",
        "2B",
        "2C",
        "3A",
        "3B",
        "3C",
        "3D",
        "4",
        "II–III NOS"
      )
    )
  )


addmargins(table(data$stage_recode))

#clean summary stage as well, since the granular stage will be used in PSM but can't be reported to table 1 given too small n
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    STAGE_GROUP = factor(
      case_when(
        COMBINED_SUMMARY_STAGE_2004 == "1" ~ "Localized",
        COMBINED_SUMMARY_STAGE_2004 == "2" ~ "Regional",
        COMBINED_SUMMARY_STAGE_2004 == "7" ~ "Distant",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("Localized", "Regional", "Distant")
    )
  )
table(data$STAGE_GROUP, useNA = "ifany")

```

4. Age at dx: categorical
  a. levels: 66-75, 76-85, 86+
  b. check that groups are ~ balanced
  c. variable name: AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100
    
```{r}
table(data$AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100)
str(data$AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    age_recode = factor(
      case_when(
        AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100 <=75 ~ "66-75",
        AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100 >75 & AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100 <=85 ~ "76-85",
        AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100 > 85 ~ "86+"
      ),
      levels = c("66-75", "76-85", "86+")
    )
  )
table(data$age_recode)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    age_75_binary = case_when(
      AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100 < 75 ~ "<75",
      AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100 >= 75 ~ "75+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    age_75_binary = factor(age_75_binary, levels = c("<75", "75+"))
  )
table(data$age_75_binary, useNA = "ifany")

summary(data$days_dx_to_tx)
```

9. Days from dx to ICI receipt
  a. variable name: days_dx_to_tx
  b. keep it continuous
```{r}
str(data$days_dx_to_tx)
summary(data$days_dx_to_tx)

#consider categorizing
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(x = days_dx_to_tx)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 90, 180, 365, 730, 1825),
    labels = c("0", "3m", "6m", "1y", "2y", "5y")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Days from diagnosis to ICI",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    dx_to_ici_recode = cut(
      days_dx_to_tx,
      breaks = c(0, 90, 180, 365, 730, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "Less than 3 months",
        "3 to 6 months",
        "6 to 12 months",
        "1 to 2 years",
        "Greater than 2 years"
      ),
      right = TRUE
    )
  )
table(data$dx_to_ici_recode)
#explore using tertiles:
quantile(
  data$days_dx_to_tx,
  probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    days_dx_to_tx_cat = cut(
      days_dx_to_tx,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 180, 730, Inf),
      labels = c("<6 months", "6 months–2 years", "≥2 years"),
      right = TRUE
    )
  )
table(data$days_dx_to_tx_cat)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    time_to_ici = case_when(
      days_dx_to_tx <= 90 ~ "≤3 months",
      days_dx_to_tx <= 365 ~ "3–12 months",
      days_dx_to_tx > 365 ~ ">12 months",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    time_to_ici = factor(time_to_ici, levels = c("≤3 months", "3–12 months", ">12 months"))
  )

table(data$time_to_ici, useNA = "ifany")


```

15. Mets at Dx:
1. Need to load in the data from sas outcomes file, which contains the mets at ICI index covariate info
```{r}
#seer based
class(data$SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_BRAIN_2010)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    seer_mets_brain = as.integer(as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_BRAIN_2010) == "1"),
    seer_mets_bone  = as.integer(as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSAT_DX_BONE_2010) == "1"),
    seer_mets_liver = as.integer(as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_LIVER_2010) == "1"),
    seer_mets_lung  = as.integer(as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSAT_DX_LUNG_2010) == "1"),
    
    n_mets_seer = seer_mets_brain + seer_mets_bone + seer_mets_liver + seer_mets_lung,
    
    n_mets_seer_cat = case_when(
      n_mets_seer == 1 ~ "1",
      n_mets_seer >= 2 ~ "2+",
      TRUE             ~ "None/Unknown"
    ),
    n_mets_seer_cat = factor(n_mets_seer_cat, levels = c("1", "2+", "None/Unknown"))
  )

table(data$n_mets_seer, useNA = "always")
table(data$n_mets_seer_cat, data$exposure_arm, useNA = "always")
```

```{r}
getwd()

# Ensure patient_id types match
data <- data %>% mutate(PATIENT_ID = as.character(PATIENT_ID))
outcomes <- outcomes %>% mutate(PATIENT_ID = as.character(PATIENT_ID))

# Identify outcome columns not already in data (excluding patient_id)
new_cols <- setdiff(names(outcomes), names(data))
new_cols <- setdiff(new_cols, "PATIENT_ID")

# Keep only patient_id + new columns from outcomes
outcomes_slim <- outcomes %>%
  select(PATIENT_ID, all_of(new_cols)) %>%
  distinct(PATIENT_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)   # protect against duplicates

# Left join: preserves all rows in data; adds only new outcomes columns
data_merged <- data %>%
  left_join(outcomes_slim, by = "PATIENT_ID")
```

Full Analysis for Utilization Paper:
```{r}

# =============================================================================
# TABLE 1: Full cohort, stratified by 4 index regimens
# =============================================================================

cat_vars_t1 <- c(
  "age_75_binary", "sex_recode", "race_binary", "radiation_binary", "yost_tertile",
  "YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS",
  "STAGE_GROUP", "seer_brain_dx", "n_mets_cat", "histo_C", "primary_site_group",
  "pre_ici_surg", "charlson_recode", "autoimmune_recode", "braf_recode",
  "time_to_ici", "firstline_ici_recode"
)

cont_vars_t1 <- c("days_dx_to_tx")

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    index_regimen = factor(index_regimen, levels = c(
      "IPILIMUMAB", "PEMBROLIZUMAB", "NIVOLUMAB", "IPILIMUMAB + NIVOLUMAB"
    ))
  )
#install.packages("tableone")
library(tableone)
table1 <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = c(cat_vars_t1, cont_vars_t1),
  strata = "index_regimen",
  data = data,
  factorVars = cat_vars_t1,
  addOverall = TRUE
)

# Store as data frame
table1_df <- as.data.frame(print(table1, 
                                  showAllLevels = TRUE, 
                                  formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","),
                                  quote = FALSE, 
                                  noSpaces = TRUE, 
                                  printToggle = FALSE))


# =============================================================================
# TABLE 1 POPULATION: Distant stage
# =============================================================================
table(data$index_regimen)

data_t2 <- data %>%
  filter(
    STAGE_GROUP == "Distant"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    index_regimen = droplevels(factor(index_regimen)),
    exposure_arm = factor(exposure_arm,
                          levels = c("Single (PD-1 or CTLA-4) ICI therapy",
                                     "Dual (PD-1 + CTLA-4) ICI therapy")),
    dual = ifelse(exposure_arm == "Dual (PD-1 + CTLA-4) ICI therapy", 1, 0)
  )
cat(sprintf("\nTable 2 analytic cohort: N = %d (Single = %d, Dual = %d)\n",
            nrow(data_t2),
            sum(data_t2$dual == 0),
            sum(data_t2$dual == 1)))


# =============================================================================
# TABLE 2: Descriptive — Dual vs Single (distant)
# =============================================================================

cat_vars_t2 <- c(
  "YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS", "sex_recode", "race_binary", "radiation_binary", "yost_tertile",
  "pre_ici_surg", "charlson_recode", "autoimmune_recode", "braf_recode",
  "time_to_ici", "firstline_ici_recode", "histo_C", "primary_site_group",
  "mets_brain_claims", "n_mets_cat", "index_regimen"
)

cont_vars_t2 <- c("days_dx_to_tx", "AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100")

table2 <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = c(cat_vars_t2, cont_vars_t2),
  strata = "exposure_arm",
  data = data_t2,
  factorVars = cat_vars_t2,
  addOverall = TRUE
)

# Store as data frame
table2_df <- as.data.frame(print(table2, 
                                  smd = TRUE, 
                                  showAllLevels = TRUE, 
                                  quote = FALSE, 
                                  noSpaces = TRUE, 
                                  printToggle = FALSE))



# =============================================================================
# FIGURE 1: Time series — regimen trends over time (Distant cohort)
# =============================================================================
library(ggrepel)
# Step 1: ts_dist with prop 
ts_dist <- data_t2 %>%
  mutate(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS = as.numeric(as.character(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS))) %>%
  count(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS, index_regimen) %>%
  group_by(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: label_data from ts_dist (already has numeric YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS)
regimen_labels <- c(
  "IPILIMUMAB"             = "Ipilimumab",
  "IPILIMUMAB + NIVOLUMAB" = "Ipi+Nivo",
  "PEMBROLIZUMAB"          = "Pembrolizumab",
  "NIVOLUMAB"              = "Nivolumab"
)

label_data <- ts_dist %>%
  group_by(index_regimen) %>%
  filter(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS == max(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(regimen_label = regimen_labels[as.character(index_regimen)])

# Step 3: verify before plotting
names(ts_dist)  # must show prop

# Step 4: plot
ggplot(ts_dist, aes(x = YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS, y = prop,
                    color = index_regimen, group = index_regimen)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = label_data,
    aes(label = regimen_label),
    nudge_x = 0.3,
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "IPILIMUMAB"             = "#F39B7F",
      "IPILIMUMAB + NIVOLUMAB" = "#E64B35",
      "PEMBROLIZUMAB"          = "#4DBBD5",
      "NIVOLUMAB"              = "#00A087"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year of Diagnosis",
    y = "Proportion of Patients",
    title = "Trends in ICI Regimen Selection Among Melanoma Patients",
    subtitle = "Distant at Diagnosis, SEER-Medicare, 2013–2019"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_main <- ggplot(ts_dist, aes(x = YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS, y = prop,
                    color = index_regimen, group = index_regimen)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = label_data,
    aes(label = regimen_label),
    nudge_x = 0.3,
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "IPILIMUMAB"             = "#F39B7F",
      "IPILIMUMAB + NIVOLUMAB" = "#E64B35",
      "PEMBROLIZUMAB"          = "#4DBBD5",
      "NIVOLUMAB"              = "#00A087"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year of Diagnosis",
    y = "Proportion of Patients",
    title = "Trends in ICI Regimen Selection Among Melanoma Patients",

  ) +
``` 

```{r}



# =============================================================================
# TABLE 3: Binary logistic regression — Dual vs Single
# =============================================================================
data_t2 <- data_t2 %>%
  mutate(
    YEAR_CAT = case_when(
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS %in% c("2013", "2014") ~ "2013–2014",
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS == "2015" ~ "2015",
      YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS %in% c("2016", "2017", "2018", "2019") ~ "2016+"
    ),
    YEAR_CAT = factor(YEAR_CAT,
                      levels = c("2015", "2013–2014", "2016+")) # sets 2015 as reference
  )
str(data_t2$YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS)
model_t3 <- glm(
  dual ~ YEAR_CAT + age_75_binary + sex_recode + race_binary + radiation_binary + yost_tertile +
    pre_ici_surg + charlson_recode + autoimmune_recode +
    braf_recode + time_to_ici + firstline_ici_recode + histo_C +
    primary_site_group + mets_brain_claims + n_mets_cat,
  data = data_t2,
  family = binomial
)
#check model convergence:
#install.packages("cars")
library(car)
vif(model_t3)
alias(model_t3)
library("broom")

table(data_t2$index_regimen)
# Store as data frame
results_t3 <- tidy(model_t3, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)

table3_df <- results_t3 %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    ),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)%s", estimate, conf.low, conf.high, sig)
  ) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  select(term, estimate_ci, p.value)
cat_vars_mvr <- c("YEAR_CAT", "age_75_binary", "sex_recode", "race_binary", "radiation_binary", "yost_tertile",
    "pre_ici_surg", "charlson_recode", "autoimmune_recode", 
    "braf_recode", "time_to_ici", "firstline_ici_recode", "histo_C", 
    "primary_site_group", "mets_brain_claims", "n_mets_cat")
# Percent dual ICI users within each level of each variable
map(cat_vars_mvr, function(var) {
  data_t2 %>%
    group_by(.data[[var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_dual  = sum(exposure_arm == "Dual (PD-1 + CTLA-4) ICI therapy", na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_dual = round(n_dual / n_total * 100, 1)
    ) %>%
    mutate(variable = var) %>%
    relocate(variable)
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  print(n = 100)



# =============================================================================
# SUPPLEMENTAL: Multinomial model (full cohort, all regimens)
# =============================================================================

data_supp <- data %>%
  filter(!YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS %in% c(2013, 2014, 2015)) %>%
  mutate(
    index_regimen = relevel(droplevels(factor(index_regimen)),
                            ref = "IPILIMUMAB + NIVOLUMAB"),
    dx_year_recode = factor(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS)
  )

library(nnet)
model_supp <- multinom(
  index_regimen ~ YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS + age_75_binary + sex_recode + race_binary + radiation_binary + yost_tertile +
    STAGE_GROUP + pre_ici_surg + charlson_recode +
    autoimmune_recode + braf_recode + time_to_ici + firstline_ici_recode +
    histo_C + primary_site_group + mets_brain_claims + n_mets_cat + index_regimen,
  data = data_supp
)

results_supp <- tidy(model_supp, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)

stable1_df <- results_supp %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    ),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)%s", estimate, conf.low, conf.high, sig)
  ) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  select(y.level, term, estimate_ci) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = y.level, values_from = estimate_ci)
```

```{r, fig.width=10}
    ),

#generate plot
ggplot(or_df, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Adjusted Odds Ratio (log scale)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Factors Associated with Receipt of Dual vs Single ICI Therapy",
    subtitle = "Adjusted odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
